goal: Add a fail-closed S.I.R.E.-aligned source integrity seal that hashes exact game, art, docs and integration source without falsely certifying gameplay or release.
requirements: Use exact candidate Git SHA, trusted ancestor and clean tree to reject stale, dirty or untrusted source
Reuse existing structure guard and remain additive without touching art, Godot or phone originals
Hash real tracked Git blobs with SHA-256/SHA3-256 and output deterministic Merkle tree outside repo
Refuse symlinks, unresolved LFS pointers, missing mandatory source, unsupported approval claims
Preserve explicit LAW-104/105/106/108/115 boundary; never self-sign, auto-deploy, install agents or claim release
completion_criteria: Source seal and code/phone configuration protected by existing layout contract
Adversarial tests reject dirty tree, stale SHA, missing paths, altered receipt and false release status
Exact-head CI source receipt and original headless Godot logs are available with SHA-bound claims
Unchanged game assets, S.I.R.E. integrations, Korvex local folder and downloaded docs preserved
No final signature, runtime scene visuals, device or game release claimed without independent proof
rollback: Close the stacked draft source-seal PR and retain the parent branch; never overwrite or delete approved sources, keys or media.
